_comment: Which of Tasker's actions, events, states and behaviours came in, went or changed on which release, for compat.py.
Data, not code, and built from the release notes at https://tasker.joaoapps.com/changes.html (one page per release).
'releases'    every release the notes cover, oldest first: its number as Tasker shows it, its date where the notes
give one, and the lowest Android API level Tasker itself runs on from that release ('min_android', 0 =
'target_api'  the releases that raised the Android API level Tasker targets, which changes what background code
may do on newer Android versions whatever the configuration says.
'items'       an action, event or state, the first release that has it, and the lowest Android API level it works on
('android', 0 = not stated).  'key' is the Tasker code plus t (action), e (event) or s (state), like
actionc.action_codes; '' when MapTasker has no code for it, in which case the row is reference only.
'changes'     a release that removed, renamed or changed something in a way that can break a configuration written
before it.  'keys' are the actions, events and states it affects; empty means it affects everything.
'named' says what they are called for the reader.  'kind' is removed, renamed or changed.
Scenes V2 (the Show, Dismiss, Update, Get, Wait For, Run and Trigger Scene v2 actions and the Scene V2 Event) came in with 6.7.1, per the author;
the rest of the 6.7 notes sit under 6.7.8, the series' last heading, and may have come in earlier.
An item or change is here because the notes say so, in their wording shortened and put in other words.  The notes list
options added to actions that already existed; those are not here, since a backup cannot tell them apart.
tests/test_compat.py holds every 'key' to actionc and every 'since' to readiness.json where both have one.

changes.text: A value starting with ~R or !~R in a match now means regular expression or negated regular expression.
Lock Screen became Display > Turn Off.
Scan Card became Scan Media.
Set Tasker Pref can no longer be called from other apps.
Set Time Zone is unavailable on Android 8 and later.
Silent Mode became Vibrate Mode.
Splitter text in Variable Split and Array Set now accepts newlines.
Wifi Tether needs root on Android 7; the plugin is the alternative.
App creation no longer has the Use External Storage preference; it always uses internal storage.
Compose Email now lists only email apps.
HTTP actions accept user-installed HTTPS certificates.
%DATE is rendered with the system locale.
On Android 6 and later, Do Not Disturb, ringer and system volume actions use the Do Not Disturb permission.
The Android Cloud Backup option is gone; use Google Drive Backup.
The Do Not Disturb option None was renamed No Interruptions.
App Info always returns non-array variables, and arrays only when needed.
HTTP Request sends no body with GET and HEAD, and takes its upload content type from Headers.
In app events the first %evtprm value is now the package name.
Output variables set to null are now empty instead of the text null.
The Mobile Network state now needs the READ_PHONE_STATE permission.
Reading the clipboard in the background on Android 10 needs WRITE_SECURE_SETTINGS.
Variable Clear clears all user variables only when Clear All Variables is selected.
Empty String values are treated as unset in every condition.
For File Modified, %evtprm(1) is now the path of the changed file, URL-decoded.
Kill App uses ADB Wifi when it is available.
Task names can no longer contain a percent sign.
Exit Tasks of active Profiles are no longer run at shutdown when Tasker is disabled.
The option to insert an SMS into the messaging database was removed.
End Call no longer works as before on Android 10 and later.
The Variable Value state no longer accepts built-in variables that are not monitored.
Wifi toggling is done through the Tasker Settings app.
Numbers in conditions are compared to 6 decimals instead of 3.
Ping always times out after 10 seconds.
Record Audio lost its Codec option; the codec follows the format.
The Device Idle state lost its Enabled option.
Return can no longer overwrite the %caller() array.
App Info clears its existing array variables before setting new ones.
Empty JavaScript local variables are empty strings, not undefined.
SQL Query clears its result array before each query.
Tasker targets API 30, so some shell commands behave differently.
Text Dialog became Text/Image Dialog.
The WebView Scene element lost its App Cache API option.
ADB Wifi's default timeout is now 10 seconds, not 1.
Input Dialog is multi-line by default.
Power Menu Action became Device Control (Power Menu Action).
Refactor Into Task became Convert Into Task.
Toggle Split Screen does not work on Android 13 and later.
Variables passed to a Task keep their original value outside it when changed inside.
Wifi Tether became WiFi Tether (Hotspot).
Bluetooth and Network Access toggling use the Tasker Settings app.
Intent Received writes bundle extras as JSON instead of Bundle.toString().
Notify icons use the system colour by default instead of white.
Test Net's Local Network IP Address returns an array of all addresses, not one value.
Wifi Connected and Wifi Near need the NEARBY_WIFI_DEVICES permission on Android 13.
HTTP Request sets its default content type only if you did not.
Run Shell now sets %err when the command ends in error.
Wifi, Bluetooth and Kill App use the Device Owner permission when it is available.
Data Backup cannot run while the device is locked.
WiFi Net now uses the Tasker Settings app.
Calendar Insert moved into the new Calendar category.
Importing a Task or Profile ignores arguments of the wrong type instead of skipping the whole action.
Airplane Mode, Wifi, Bluetooth, Kill App, Mobile Data and Sound Mode use Shizuku when it is available.
App Factory is no longer updated.
Notifications no longer group unless the Group setting is used, even on Android 16.
Work Profile was renamed Work Profile/Private Space and now toggles both.
Array Push and Array Pop on a global fire Variable Set for each changed position.
Device Boot no longer fires on Android 15 and later after the app was force stopped.
Wifi Connect shows an error if the device's location setting is off.
